To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) The use of the WP04, B3PW91, and B3LYP density functionals with the 6‐311 + + G(2df, 2p) basis set is recommended for the computation of 1H NMR chemical shifts.
1) the B3LYP and WC04 methods are the most reliable for predicting the chemical shifts of diastereomere penam β‐Lactams and 2) the B3PW91 method is the least reliable.

(1) DFT methods are capable of identifying correct stereoisomers based upon computed chemical shifts, but (2) the ability to discriminate between stereoisomers depends strongly upon the method used, (3) the ability to predict chemical shifts is not a reliable measure of a DFT method’s ability to distinguish among stereoisomers, and (4) the best method for discriminating between stereoisomers is B3LYP/IEFPCM/6‐31 + G(d).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new synthetic methodologies for the preparation of penam β-lactam analogues.
the application of density functional theory to the prediction of 1H and13C NMR spectroscopic data.

the development and application of computational chemistry methods for the determination of the relative energies and structures of organic molecules and the development of computational chemistry methods to predict the NMR spectra of organic molecules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the B3LYP/IEFPCM/6‐311++ G(2d, p) level of theory, as implemented in the Gaussian 03 program, is the best approach for predicting 1H chemical shifts in the penam β‐ lactams studied in this work.
the best method for predicting 1H NMR shifts for penams is IEFPCM/BP86/6‐311++G(2d,p), whereas IEFPCM/BLYP/6 ‐311++G(3d,p) is the best method for 13C shifts.
the B3LYP/IEFPCM method, using the 1H chemical shifts, is the best method to distinguish stereoisomers of penams.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for the penam β‐lacatams studied here, the computed 1H NMR data were generally more reliable than the computed 13C data for identifying the correct stereosomer.
, for the penams studied, the DFT‐based approaches are capable of distinguishing among diastereomers on the basis of computed 1H chemical shifts but not 13C chemical shift data.
the B3LYP/IEFPCM/6‐31 + G(d) method is the best compromise between accuracy and cost for predicting 1H NMR shifts for penam β‐Lactams.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ability of DFT to distinguish among stereoisomers based solely on NMR chemical shifts can be improved by using a combination of the WP04 and WC04 functionals.
the B3LYP functional performs best for predicting NMR chemical shifts, and it performs better than the other functionals for predicting 13C chemical shift differences.
the B3LYP/IEFPCM method can predict the correct diastereomers of penam β-lactams with an accuracy of 80% using the 1H chemical shift data and 50% using the 13C chemical shift data.
